_readme: WP7 integration scenarios: real verified cards as the v2 loader publishes them (db/fixtures/catalogue_v2_cards snapshots, trimmed to the fields the engines read), with the context and the issuer-verified expectations of one worked example each.

Only the keys a worked example states are asserted (assert list, C8 D10): the expected currency amount, excluded, cap deltas, and value_inr when given. rule_id and the other currency are not asserted.

No engine bug was found by WP7 (JS and Dart agree on all 388 engine-checkable examples), so there are no engine-bug corrections here. Regenerate after a snapshot change: the scenario cards are copies of the snapshots.
